title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 3, QA) - Quant - Functions
subject: Quant

questions.q: For any non-zero real number ${x}$, let $f(x)+2 f(\frac{1}{x})=3 x$. Then, the sum of all possible values of ${x}$ for which $f(x)=3$, is:
questions.explain: First, solve for f(x). Replace x with 1/x to get a second equation: $f(1/x) + 2f(x) = 3/x$. Solve the system for f(x) to get $f(x) = 2/x - x$. Set $f(x)=3$, so $2/x - x = 3$. This leads to $x^2+3x-2=0$. The sum of roots is -b/a = -3.
